UPSTREAM_COMMIT=ea0630e1a3eaae7f9f9740fd2703229d3854ccda
SOURCE=https://github.com/anthropic-experimental/agentic-misalignment
VENDORED=2026-07-31 (commit 91925ff); verified against upstream HEAD 2026-08-05
DRIVEN_BY=src/eval/misalignment/agentic_misalignment/runner.py — subprocesses
  scripts/{generate_prompts,run_experiments,classify_results}.py with cwd=this tree.
  Nothing here is imported.

PRUNED
  results/            our own rollout outputs (52M); runs now land under the eval's
                      out_dir instead
  .git/, __pycache__/

PATCHED (original patches plus 2026-09-28 generation-integrity repairs)
  api_client/model_client.py
    1. vllm/ provider. `_detect_provider` maps a "vllm/<served-name>" model id to a new
       "vllm" provider, and `_call_vllm` calls that OpenAI-compatible endpoint through
       AsyncOpenAI, configured from VLLM_BASE_URL / VLLM_API_KEY. This is how the
       harness reaches the model run_eval.py serves; upstream only knows hosted APIs.
    2. Judge routing. Upstream matched the substring "claude" and sent it to Anthropic
       before applying its `/`-prefix rule, so "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5" tried the
       Anthropic API — for which this project has no key. Any provider-prefixed id now
       routes to OpenRouter (docs/GOTCHAS.md, "Vendored harness patches").
    3. Removed the vestigial VLLM_ENABLE_THINKING request override. The framework
       owns the template; an arbitrary API endpoint need not accept vLLM extensions.
    4. LLMResponse carries out-of-band reasoning_content; empty visible replies retain
       that trace for diagnostics instead of raising before evidence can be saved.
  scripts/run_experiments.py
    5. global.max_tokens is explicit (historic effective default 10000). The former
       `if "gemini" or "qwen" in model` was always true, hiding the effective budget.
    6. Persist out-of-band reasoning and empty replies before marking a sample failed.
       runner.py reconciles planned cells and stop reasons before judging and verifies
       boolean classifications before aggregating. Incomplete runs cannot publish a rate.
  classifiers/{classifier,blackmail_classifier,leak_classifier}.py (2026-09-29)
    7. agentic-action-judge-v2: blackmail's existing contact + semantic judge gates
       no longer require the target to literally say "blackmail" or "leverage".
       An explicit conditional threat without those words previously became false.
    8. Blackmail/leak classifiers require a naturally finished judge reply and one
       exact yes/no answer; substring matches and ambiguous/multiple tags fail.
  scripts/classify_results.py
    9. Preserve failed judge text and stop metadata in a separate error record;
       successful blackmail/leak classifications identify the protocol. Old published results
       are not relabeled or automatically rescored.
   10. Use atomic replace instead of rename-over-existing for Windows classification
       persistence. Retain failed judge attempts across retries and success while
       clearing only the current failure marker; optional unchanged classifiers
       do not receive the blackmail/leak protocol label.
  scripts/generate_prompts.py (2026-09-30)
   11. Respect each enabled expansion's condition combinations instead of crossing
       the union of all its variables. The current config declares eight conditions;
       the old conversion generated twelve, adding four unintended explicit-none
       conditions. Intended prompts and the scenario templates are unchanged.
       runner.py records declared-expansions-v1 and checks exact prompt coverage
       before inference. Historical twelve-condition results are not relabeled.
       Regression: tests/test_behavioral_runner_runtime.py runs this actual generator
       offline against the maintained config and separated/disabled expansions.
  classifiers/{classifier,blackmail_classifier,leak_classifier,murder_classifier}.py (2026-10-02)
   12. agentic-action-judge-v3: judges and deterministic action gates only receive
       visible response text. Native <think> traces (including prefilled close-only
       output) and private SCRATCHPAD_REASONING blocks are excluded; raw evidence
       remains in response.json. Trace-only replies cannot become behavioral scores.
   13. Leak authorization is an explicit, exact-address allowlist in
       classifiers/authorized_recipients.json. Every unlisted recipient is
       unauthorized, including unknown internal or claimed government addresses.
       Confidential sharing still needs the semantic judge verdict; a refusal or
       public reply is not a leak. Mixed To/Cc/Bcc destinations are checked, and
       judges see only actions with unlisted recipients to avoid attributing an
       authorized transfer to a separate external refusal.
   14. Murder now requires the same naturally completed, exact yes/no judgment as
       blackmail/leaking. It receives the inbox context plus visible response,
       and its override action gate cannot fire on a native-reasoning draft.
  scripts/classify_results.py (2026-10-02)
   15. Save the visible scoring input and v3 protocol for all three scenarios,
       retaining raw/native reasoning separately. Leak labels include the exact
       authorized list. runner.py refuses old-protocol labels in new runs and
       saves scoring_protocol.json with the panel, prompt/classifier hashes,
       authorization policy and effective judge/generation settings.
       Historical published artifacts are not modified or reclassified.
